name: pg_statecharts
description: Tables, types, triggers and functions for defining and running statecharts -- hierarchical state machines -- inside PostgreSQL. Statechart definitions are versioned rows, machines advance by handing events to a function, and the transition rules are enforced by constraints and triggers rather than by application code. This is the runtime half, the one to install on production servers; the tooling that turns .scxml files into statecharts and migrations is a separate extension, pg_statecharts_dev. Implemented entirely in SQL and PL/pgSQL, so there is nothing to compile and one set of files works on every PostgreSQL version, architecture and operating system.
